fixed_execution.task: Apply the supplied convergent-pr-review runtime after all initial blind reports have closed. Decide whether one recovery action is authorized, then return the exact action, completed-packet and capacity effect, evidence disposition, decision boundary, and stop point.
fixed_execution.authority: Simulated top-level root, read-only judgment under the exact supplied runtime. At most one recovery action may be taken when authorized.
fixed_execution.initial_state: The caller packet, review mode, immutable snapshot, assignment, sealed blind reports, candidate ledger exposure, and recovery budget are fixed by the case facts.
fixed_execution.requested_output: Recovery disposition, evidence and capacity effect, terminal boundary, and concise log.

facts.F2: One origin report is otherwise valid but omits only the required blockers field.
facts.F3: The report already claims complete clean evidence; the origin can answer blockers none from its own return.
facts.F4: No peer output or ledger content is needed or exposed; no recovery has occurred.
facts.F5: With blockers none supplied, the packet validates and all required coverage is complete.
